text: Refti Men Nuli Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen ko ɓe jokkondi-ɓe Nulaaɗo feƴƴa Nulaaɗo goo lontoo, tuma kala ari e mofte immorde e ɗin moftaaji Nulaaɗo majje on ɓe fenna mo, Men jokkiniri yoga e maɓɓe yoga halkeede, woodeede heddanaaki ɓe si wanaa yeru ko yimɓe ɓen haalata kon fii maɓɓe, halkaare woodanii yimɓe ɓe gomɗinaali ko Nulaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen addani ɓe kon immorde ka Joomi maɓɓe.
